semiconductor_relevance: High — Puritic Shanghai Corporation provides essential equipment and materials for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Puritic Shanghai Corporation specializes in supplying equipment and consumable parts for semiconductor facilities, including valves, fittings, and purification systems. They focus on delivering quality service and technical expertise to support semiconductor and optoelectronic manufacturing.

regional_presence.China: Puritic Shanghai Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Taiwan Puritic Corporation, focusing on the Chinese market.
